semantic_deltas: Archive every resolved selected-B query before a lineage terminal event; exact positives form D+ and exact negatives remain truthful D-.
Retain the original sampled flow base paired with each archived candidate when available.
Pair preterminal reset scenarios and flow-base lineages across gamma by the same counter-based round/replica/step coordinates.
Add per-gamma sliding-positive GP modes with strict previous-round causality.
Exclude exact-negative and verifier-error rows from GP support defensively.
Balance bounded GP support by gamma, then trajectory/lineage, then uniform time stage rather than query multiplicity.

Add an opt-in executed-plus-terminal-NVP archive path whose D+ rows are exact-positive sampled H10 proposals selected for first-action execution and whose D- rows are resolved-invalid, explicitly unexecuted terminal counterfactuals.
Rank a terminal NVP counterfactual D- by the same J_native minus lambda times one-step margin score used for execution.
Add a frozen-phi, per-gamma sliding GP mode containing only prior-round executed D+ rows, with an optional explicit reference-round window.
Add an opt-in last-residual-block-plus-head optimizer scope while preserving every legacy optimizer scope.
Allow a deliberate finite early-acquisition horizon to terminate as EARLY_CUTOFF rather than scientific TIMEOUT.
Reuse each already-computed posterior covariance for marginal sigma and sequential without-replacement acquisition; this is a fixed-seed-equivalent performance change.
unchanged: Legacy archive and GP modes remain selectable.
NVP remains fail-closed and no fallback controller is introduced.
Verifier labels, execution ranking, dynamics, visualization, and task adapters are not changed by this patch.
